page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.24xlarge is an enterprise compute instance configured within the High Clock Speed server line. Running on KVM hypervisor infrastructure with the x86_64 instruction set, the host delivers 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor maintaining a 3.4 GHz clock frequency. The architecture is supported by 768 GB of total system RAM, corresponding to an 8.0 GB memory allocation per dedicated core.

Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 48 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addressing. The instance does not include bundled local disk storage, which means persistent and scratch filesystems must be provisioned through remote network block storage services. Discrete GPU accelerators are not present, focusing the host exclusively on CPU calculations and memory interaction.

Because the hardware combines a 3.4 GHz clock frequency with an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio, it optimizes resource density for workloads demanding rapid instruction execution alongside substantial memory occupancy. Cost efficiency is driven by consolidating heavy enterprise services that require both single-thread execution speed and high RAM capacity into a single dedicated footprint, rather than scaling out across multiple smaller nodes. Primary use cases include in-memory databases, electronic design automation, batch financial modeling, distributed caching, and high-concurrency enterprise application servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.24xlarge is a high clock speed, memory-dense virtual machine within the High Clock Speed instance family. Built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture, this instance supplies 96 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.4 GHz. System memory totals 768 GB, offering an allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU to facilitate large in-memory footprints alongside elevated per-core compute capacity. Network throughput is provisioned at a 48 Gbps baseline. The configuration provides no bundled local disks, relying entirely on external network-attached block storage for operating system and data requirements, and contains no integrated GPU accelerators. With its combination of high CPU clock frequency, extensive memory allocation, and high-speed network connectivity, this server addresses enterprise workloads such as large in-memory databases, real-time data streaming engines, distributed caching clusters, and high-throughput transaction processing systems.
